reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, batch 2

samples_reviewed.question_text: What is the place value of the digit 0 in 20?
What is the place value of the digit 1 in 15?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency requires adding numbers with sums up to 1000 IN EXPANDED FORM, but none of the five samples show expanded-form notation at all -- they are plain facts ('What is 1 + 12?') or unrelated place-value cloze items ('place value of the digit 0 in 20'), and the largest observed sum is only 46, nowhere near the stated 1000 ceiling.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: addition (4 axes/8 combos) and place_value (2 axes/8 combos) give 16 combined combos; an expanded-form-specific combo may exist elsewhere in that space, and exhaustive execution is validated separately by validate_matrix, but none of the 5 illustrative samples surfaced it.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Stems are short (under 10 words) and single-step, appropriate reading level for grade 2 quarter 1, though the content itself is not testing the more demanding expanded-form skill the competency names.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Pulling in the place_value DNA alongside addition is a sensible pairing for expanded-form work, but nothing in the 5 samples demonstrates the two DNAs combining into an actual expanded-form addition item, raising doubt that the registered combos actually produce the target format.

competency_alignment.rationale: A node meant to bridge basic addition into expanded-form addition to 1000 should show a clear progression toward decomposed place-value addends; instead the samples regress to trivial add-zero-or-near-zero facts (1+12, 0+25, 0+46) more at home in an earlier node.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Observed sums top out at 46 against a stated ceiling of 1000 -- a two order-of-magnitude gap that, if representative, means the harder end of this node's intended range is essentially untested by these samples.
